Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 2010
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 2010
NATIONAL ACCOUNTABILITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2010
An Ordinance further to
amend the National Accountability Ordinance, 1999
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part - I, 16th September, 2010]
No.2(I)/2010-Pub., dated 16-9-2010.--The following
Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for general
information: --
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the National Accountability Ordinance, 1999 (XVIII
of 1999), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the
National Assembly and the Senate are not in session and the President is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution
of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the National Accountability (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Amendment of section 16A, Ordinance XVIII of 1999

Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution
of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:--
2. Amendment of
section 16A, Ordinance XVIII of 1999.--In the National Accountability Ordinance, 1999 (XVIII of 1999),
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 16A, after subsection
(a), the following new subsection shall be inserted, namely:
"(aa) Power of Federal Government to
transfer cases.--Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for
the time being in force, where a new Accountability Court(s) has been
established at any place, the Federal Government may by order transfer cases
and proceedings pending before other Accountability Court(s) to such newly
established Court(s) relating to its territorial jurisdiction and it shall not
be necessary for such Court(s) to recall any witness again or to record any
evidence that may have been recorded.".

Now, therefore, in

promulgate the following Ordinance:--
3. Substitution
of section 31E, Ordinance XVIII of 1999.---In the said Ordinance, for section 31E the
following shall be substituted, namely: -
"31E. Protection
of witnesses etc.---The Government, Chairman
NAB or the Court, within available resources, may in the facts and
circumstances of a case take such measures as may be considered necessary for
the safety, security and protection of witnesses, Judges, public prosecutors,
counsel and their families."
